{{Infobox auto}}

'''Gimmari''' are fried seaweed rolls, the meal of kelp. They heal {{Hp|6}} and grant {{EffectLink|Water Breathing}} for 8 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/gimmari.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Dried Kelp|Dried kelp]], a carrot, sugar, an egg, flour and [[oil]]. Obtaining dried kelp unlocks the recipe. The oil's glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating gimmari takes 1.2 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Water Breathing for 8:00.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
